problemStatement: Link owners want to record why a link exists and to analyse clicks in a spreadsheet. Links get an optional plain-text note (at most 280 characters), set on create and returned with the link, and the owner can export the daily clicks of a link as CSV with the same range rules and owner check as the JSON stats.

functional.text: POST /api/v1/links accepts an optional note (string, at most 280 characters); a longer note is rejected with 400 and a Problem Details body of type /problems/validation-failed.
The link responses of create (201) and GET /api/v1/links/{code} include note: the stored text, or null when none was given.
GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats.csv returns text/csv with a header row day,clicks and one row per UTC day in the range, oldest first, zero-filled.

The CSV export takes the same optional from/to parameters as GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats, with the same defaults (last 30 days), maximum (90 days) and errors (400 /problems/invalid-stats-range), and the same owner check (404 /problems/link-not-found for another key's or an unknown link).

nonFunctional.text: Existing clients keep working: note is optional on create, and links created before this change have no note.
The note is returned only to the link's owner through the management API; it never appears on the public redirect.

acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/v1/links with url and note "spring campaign"
acceptanceCriteria.then: 201 and the body has note "spring campaign"

acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/v1/links with a note of 281 characters

acceptanceCriteria.given: a link created with a note
acceptanceCriteria.then: the body has the same note

acceptanceCriteria.given: a link created without a note
a link with 2 clicks on 2026-03-02 and none on 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-03
a link owned by the caller
a link owned by another API key

acceptanceCriteria.then: 302 to the original URL and the note is not in the response

assumptions: The note is stored as given (no trimming); an empty note is stored as an empty string.
The CSV has no other columns: unique visitors, referrers and user agents stay in the JSON stats.
Notes cannot be changed after creation; there is no update endpoint for links today.

ambiguities.question: Should the CSV be offered as a download (Content-Disposition attachment)?
ambiguities.proposedDefault: attachment named <code>-clicks.csv, so browsers save it for the spreadsheet

outOfScope: Fixing the stale redirect cache after delete (known issue BF-1)
